description.value: The study evaluated grey matter density and functional connectivity in cigarette smokers and never-smokers using structural and resting-state functional MRI.

spans.text: In this study, we collected structural and resting state functional MRI data to investigate differences in brain structure (grey matter density, using voxel-based morphometry or VBM) and functional connectivity (using a region-of-interest, seed-based approach) in never-smokers and minimally-deprived (~1 hour abstinent) cigarette smokers.

description.value: Observational cross-sectional comparison of minimally deprived cigarette smokers and never-smoking control participants.
